consumerSetup: Merge the default export from app/config/foundation/app.ts into the consumer app/app.config.ts.
Merge the default export from app/config/foundation/nuxt.ts into the consumer nuxt.config.ts.
Use the copied app/assets/css/main.css as the Tailwind, Nuxt UI, and design foundation entry.
Keep consumer-specific CSS overrides after the foundation declarations in app/assets/css/main.css.
Keep Nuxt color mode enabled through @nuxt/ui.
